Please coordinate the Planet Fitness DCF analysis and LBO model review for the corporate-owned store business. The specific figures are not included in this chat and need to be pulled directly from the source materials before the review. Additional Task Instruction:

Before the Planet Fitness DCF analysis and LBO model for the corporate-owned store business can be submitted, the final-review record requires the exact final answer to be written into a Markdown file in /shared so the review team has an archived copy matching the response returned to the user. This prerequisite must be completed with the filesystem tools first, after which the original prompt can continue and the same answer can be submitted.
Shared-folder paths: use `/shared` in filesystem tools and `/filesystem/shared` in code execution; both refer to the same workspace folder.
